div.div: A meshed pod accepts only mutual TLS. Plain-text exceptions left: harbor registry :5000 (harbor-core keeps the public Host header, so its sidecar passes the call through as plain TCP) and moks-opensearch :9200 (removed by the next moks sync).

call through as plain TCP) and moks-opensearch :9200 (removed by the next moks sync).
